title: CI/CD deployment pipeline
oneLiner: Pull-request gates, a Docker image and a local release lane with a recorded rollback.

shots.alt: Mock of the blocked pull-request check page, rendered from .github/workflows/pr.yml: eight gates plus the ci-ok aggregator, with trivy expected to fail. Labelled mock; no GitHub run exists.
Recorded rollback timeline rendered from this repository's deploy.log: deploy.start, health.ok, smoke.fail, rollback.start, rollback.health.ok, rollback.smoke.ok.
The eight PR gates feeding the single required ci-ok check, rendered from pr.yml and docs/PIPELINE.md; no Actions run is depicted.
Local release lane transcript captured from the running service: release-local.sh status and five passing smoke assertions on 127.0.0.1:8787. Local only; rendered, not a screenshot.

measured.label: Smoke gate
measured.method: bash scripts/smoke.sh against the running release on 127.0.0.1:8787

measured.label: Rollback ordering
measured.value: deploy.start → health.ok → smoke.fail → rollback.start → rollback.health.ok → rollback.smoke.ok
measured.method: read deploy.log in file order (timestamps recorded by release-local.sh)

invariants.claim: Unauthenticated POST /invoices is rejected; an authenticated request returns a UUID id
GET /ready reports pending_migrations when a migration is unapplied, and is ready when database and migrations are okay
An unknown invoice id returns 404 not_found with no stack trace in the body

limits: The GitHub Actions lane has never run: git remote -v is empty, so no green CI run and no red-PR block are claimed.
Only the local release and rollback lane is measured; the Actions PostgreSQL service container is not shown to behave like local PostgreSQL 16.
Rollback returns to the previous release and only works for expand/contract migrations.
The local service runs at http://127.0.0.1:8787; there is no public URL.
